categories.name: AUD Stablecoin
categories.content: A AUD stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Australian Dollar (AUD).

categories.name: Yield Tokenization Product
categories.content: Yield tokenization product refers to converting the expected future yield or returns from an asset into tradable tokens on a blockchain, allowing for the trading, management, and optimization of yield independently from the underlying asset.

categories.name: Healthcare
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the healthcare industry.

categories.name: Uniswap v4 Hooks
categories.content: Tokens of protocols whose core product is built on Uniswap v4 hooks. Hooks turn the AMM from fixed infrastructure into a programmable platform, enabling designs that were impossible in earlier versions: dynamic fees that widen during volatility, MEV-mitigation through batched uniform-clearing-price execution, rehypothecation of idle liquidity into lending markets, vault-managed concentrated liquidity issued as fungible ERC-6909 positions, limit orders implemented as single-tick positions, and lending markets that share collateral with swap liquidity. Projects in this category use hooks as the foundation of their product rather than merely trading on Uniswap.

categories.name: Privacy Browser
categories.content: A privacy browser is a browser built or hardened to block trackers, ads, fingerprinting, and data leaks by default, keeping your activity more private from websites and advertisers.

categories.name: NFT Strategy Flywheel
categories.content: The NFT Strategy Flywheel is a DeFi-NFT hybrid model that automates NFT accumulation and token burning using trading fees to drive continuous buy pressure and value accrual for token holders.

categories.name: NFTStrategy Ecosystem
categories.content: NFTStrategy is an automated protocol that converts crypto trading fees into buying and selling floor NFTs, creating a self-sustaining value loop for NFT collections.

categories.name: Augmented Reality
categories.content: Augmented Reality (AR) offers interactive experiences without disconnecting users from the real world, allowing them to interact with digital elements in a real-world context.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Duck-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by duck.

categories.name: MetaDAO Launchpad
categories.content: MetaDAO Launchpad (https://metadao.fi/) is a Solana-based platform designed to facilitate decentralized project launches and funding, leveraging futarchy-based governance to align community and market incentives.

categories.name: MXN Stablecoin
categories.content: Stablecoins that maintain a stable value by reference to the Mexican peso (MXN).

categories.name: DaoMaker Launchpad
categories.content: DaoMaker Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Cookie Launchpad
categories.content: Cookie Launchpad is a token sale platform operated by Cookie DAO that allocates participation opportunities in three pools: one for top users ranked by on-chain and social engagement ('capital mindshare' via Cookie Snaps), one for $COOKIE token stakers in higher tiers, and a public first-come-first-served pool.

categories.name: Yoink.fun Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Yoink (https://yoinkai.fun/), an agentic launch and trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: Arcade Games
categories.content: Classic-style games with simple mechanics, high replayability, and score-based progression.

categories.name: Argus Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Argus (https://argus.world/), the permissionless token launchpad native to Arc.

categories.name: Fixed Interest
categories.content: Protocols that involved in providing financial products that include fixed interest.

categories.name: MMO
categories.content: Online games that host large numbers of players.

categories.name: Yield Tokenization Protocol
categories.content: Yield tokenization protocol refers to protocol taking a yield-bearing asset and splitting the future yield stream out to distinct token.
